offline: Server unavailable. Check connectivity and connection routes in Server access.
invalid_pairing: The pairing string is damaged. Get a new code on the machine.
unsupported_address: This address type is not supported by the application yet.
pair_code_invalid: The pairing code is invalid or expired. Get a new code.
pair_locked: Too many pairing attempts. Try again later.
device_revoked: Access for this device has been revoked. Pair it again.
languageSaveFailure: Could not save the interface language.
actionFailure: Could not complete the action. Check the connection and try again.
interfaceFailure: Could not open the application interface.
createFileFailure: Could not create a file in Downloads.
openFileFailure: Could not open a file in Downloads.
scanPrompt: Point the camera at the GrigDesk pairing QR code
unlockCancelled: Unlock was cancelled or is unavailable.
noBrowser: No browser found for this link.
cameraPermission: Allow camera access to scan the QR code.
restoreFailure: Could not restore the application state.
startupFailure: Could not open the application. Check the installation integrity.
profilesDamaged: The machine profile file is damaged.
noFreePort: No free port is available for the machine.
connectionStateFailure: Could not update the connection state.
relay_upgrade_required: Update the server relay for the current app.
relay_pin_mismatch: The relay certificate did not match: the network is intercepting the connection or the relay was recreated. At home the phone connects directly; otherwise get a new QR code.
relay_unauthorized: The relay rejected the phone key. Get a new QR code in Server access.
unpaired: Pair this device again. Get a new QR in Server access.
device_scope_forbidden: Revoke the old pairing and connect the current app with a new QR.
device_unknown: Device not found. Get a new QR code and pair it again.
appLockSaveFailure: Could not save the app lock preference.
